Sehwag's son Aryaveer plays cricket against Australia

Veerendra Sehwag's son, Aryaveer, played cricket, batting alongside the captain. In a match against Australia, the Indian team achieved a clean sweep. One report noted Aryaveer's performance on a pitch where a century was previously scored, describing him as 'flustered' like his father.
